content.intro: Use the interactive Topic Narrowing Funnel below to filter an overwhelming research interest into an operationalized, defensible empirical problem statement.
key: Broad interest areas cannot be defended in an oral examination without boundary parameters.
A rigorous topic defines four boundary anchors: Context (Where), Target Population (Who), Measured Constructs (What), and Longitudinal Horizon.
The FINER criteria (Feasible, Interesting, Novel, Ethical, Relevant) must be met before proposal submission.
